what: When the pointer rests on a round button wrapped in multicolor stripes, the border stripes slide by half their length in .4s — top edge to the right, bottom edge to the left — so the colors flow, the inner white plate grows 0.5px in .3s so the border thins, and the arrow shifts 2px — a kids facility’s ”Colored Paper Border” button

options.--fx-stripe: Striped gradient (one cell = button width). Default is the skin’s four colors of accent·text·line — to use the site confetti colors, put them here
options.[data-fx-part=edge]: Empty child element for drawing the stripes (required)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text — to sit on the board

use: View details

from.where: shared.css .button-rounded (all page buttons·footer button) — the original lays a color band image (repeat-x) over two half-width 200% plates and pushes 50% in .4s

note: CSS only — no fx.js. The striped panel is twice the button width, so overflow: hidden is needed
